map.新房装修或单间添置空调，先按面积与层高估算制冷量（普通住宅约 200–220 W: For new homes or a single room, first estimate cooling capacity by area and ceiling height (typical home ~200-220 W/m2), then convert to HP (1 HP~2324 W cooling) to avoid under-sizing and weak cooling.
map.西晒、顶层、大面积玻璃幕墙或人员密集的房间，在基础估算上叠加 10%–30% 余: For west-facing, top-floor, large glass-curtain-wall, or crowded rooms, add 10%-30% margin to the base estimate to avoid weak performance at summer peak load.
map.北方冬季依赖空调制热时，关注制热量与低温制热衰减；严寒地区优先选带电辅热或低温机: In northern regions relying on AC heating in winter, watch heating capacity and low-temperature drop; in severe cold, prefer models with auxiliary heat or low-temperature rating, and verify rated heating at the local minimum temperature.

map.220W/㎡ 这个指标怎么来的？: Where does the 220W/m2 figure come from?
map.为经验制冷负荷指标，综合围护传热、人员、设备与新风；西晒/顶层/玻璃多应上浮，潮: It is an empirical cooling-load figure combining envelope heat transfer, occupants, equipment and fresh air; raise it for west-sun/top-floor/more glass, and slightly more in humid areas. It is only a rough estimate; precise design needs a professional load calculation.
map.匹数和瓦数怎么换算？: How to convert HP and watts?
map.市场俗称 1 匹≈2324W 制冷量（小 1 匹约 2200W、大 1 匹约 2: Commonly 1 HP~2324W cooling (small 1 HP ~2200W, large 1 HP ~2600W). For purchase, use 'cooling capacity W' for accuracy; HP is just a colloquial term.
map.计算结果能直接下单吗？: Can I order directly from the result?
